findings_fixed_or_fenced: Complete positivity is an imported interface, not a Boolean requires_extension theorem. The actual normalized Bell rank-one density has nonnegative quadratic form. Partial transpose on the second tensor factor has quadratic value -t on (0,1,-1,0), with norm²2 and eigenvalue -t/2. Transpose and identity agree on classical diagonals, but differ under the admitted tensor extension. The positivity of transpose on all states and a full Stinespring theorem remain separate formal obligations.
